{{Top|leg}}
An '''armored repulsor transport''' was a combat vehicle employed by [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] stationed aboard [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]]. Each could carry a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of eighty troops, and was equipped with [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] batteries.
